chunks: On a path that is straight
ai.seo_question: What is the Straight Path (Sirat al-Mustaqim) in Islam?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the 'Sirat al-Mustaqim' is often interpreted not merely as a general path but specifically as the path of the Ahl al-Bayt and the Imams, who are considered the infallible guides and manifestations of divine truth. This phrase in Surah Yaseen reinforces the concept of Tawhid and the necessity of following the divinely appointed leadership (Imamah) to achieve spiritual rectitude, echoing the plea in Surah Al-Fatiha but emphasizing the certainty of this guidance for the believers.
